Class AnalyticsController

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.AnalyticsController
@Controller public class AnalyticsController extends Object
Serves the "My Reports" (analytics) page and the JSON endpoints behind its "view all" modals.

The desktop controller kept the selected report, the year selector and the weekly calendar month in fields and swapped the centre area in place. On the web that state lives in the URL: /analytics?report=history|weekly|monthly|yearly|songs|albums|artists plus the optional year, month, cyear (calendar year) and week parameters. Each request renders exactly one section on the server with Thymeleaf fragments from templates/analytics/.

The four paginated modals (listening history, top songs, top albums, top artists) fetch their pages from GET /api/analytics/{history|songs|albums|artists}?offset=&limit=, which return a AnalyticsController.PageResult of small records, never entities.

SRP: request mapping and mapping of view-model DTOs to view records; all data comes from the existing view models and AnalyticsCacheService.

DIP: depends on the view-model beans, not on repositories.

Time Complexity: O(n) per request, where n = playback history rows scanned by the view model.

Space Complexity: O(p) for the rows of the page or preview that is rendered.

    • analytics

      @GetMapping("/analytics") public String analytics(@RequestParam(defaultValue="history") String report, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer year, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer month, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer cyear, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer week, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the My Reports page with the selected section.

      Time Complexity: O(n) where n = playback history rows scanned by the view model.

      Space Complexity: O(1) beyond the rendered rows.

      Parameters:
      report - the section key; unknown values fall back to history
      year - the year selected in the sidebar (current year when absent or not offered)
      month - the weekly calendar month, or the monthly report month
      cyear - the weekly calendar year (defaults to year; changes when paging months across a year)
      week - the selected week of the year for the weekly report
      model - the view model
      Returns:
      the analytics template name

    • artists

      @GetMapping("/api/analytics/artists") @ResponseBody public AnalyticsController.PageResult<AnalyticsController.ArtistItem> artists(@RequestParam(defaultValue="0") int offset, @RequestParam(defaultValue="20") int limit)
      Returns one page of every artist ranked by the current user's listening time.

      The full ranked list is cached per user for 60 seconds in AnalyticsCacheService and paged in memory with DoublyLinkedList.getWindow(int, int), as the desktop did.

      Time Complexity: O(n + a) on a cache miss, O(offset + limit) on a hit.

      Parameters:
      offset - zero-based index of the first row
      limit - page size, 1 to 100
      Returns:
      the page
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - 400 when offset or limit is out of range
